purpose: Challenge the selected Campaign117 activity-sequence mechanism against the complete 142-definition frontier and freeze exactly one formula, direction, source projection, support rule and missing semantics before any Campaign117 source or candidate value is read.

frozen_candidate.name: intraday_amount_weak_order_entropy_236t
frozen_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A broader and less repetitive local ordering of one-minute CNY activity reflects distributed participation rather than a few mechanically repeated liquidity states, and may carry more orderly demand resilience from the next open through the third close.

exact_formula.state_input: Use each selected bar's raw finite nonnegative CNY amount. Because weak order is invariant to a common strictly increasing transform, no log, rank, winsorization, normalization or rescaling is applied.
exact_formula.weak_order_key: For every overlapping triple (a0,a1,a2), form (cmp(a0,a1),cmp(a0,a2),cmp(a1,a2)) with exact zero tolerance and cmp in {-1,0,+1}; retain exact ties and require one of the 13 transitive weak-order states.
exact_formula.pooling: Pool the 118 morning and 118 afternoon state labels with equal triple weight; do not form a lunch transition.
exact_formula.probabilities: For each of the 13 frozen states, p_k=count_k/236, including zero-count states.
exact_formula.score: -sum over p_k>0 of p_k*ln(p_k), divided by ln(13).
exact_formula.support: Require exactly 240 finite nonnegative amount values, strictly positive total amount, exactly 236 recognized transitive triples, a finite score and an in-range score; otherwise missing. Zero-amount bars and exact ties remain informative states.

overlap_challenges.distinction: Mass entropy is invariant to clock permutation and uses normalized magnitudes; serial persistence and path efficiency use cardinal differences or correlation. Campaign117 discards amount magnitudes after exact comparisons, changes with local ordering, and is invariant to a common strictly increasing amount transform.

Those factors retain one event category, one threshold run, one global peak or a terminal mass. Campaign117 uses all 13 local weak-order states with no amount threshold and no absolute clock label. Equal peak counts can have different full state distributions and entropy.

Campaign117 never reads a close, return, sign or volatility state. Arbitrarily changing the price path while preserving amount leaves Campaign117 unchanged but can change every listed price-activity factor.

The finite alphabet is a documented operator precedent, but the information state is CNY activity rather than return or high-low range. Changing amount order while holding all OHLC paths fixed changes Campaign117 and leaves these price definitions unchanged. Campaign117 also uses marginal entropy, not reversal divergence.
Campaign117 pools within-half local triples and has no aligned half, prior-day or market profile. Permuting local neighborhoods while preserving aligned profile similarity can change Campaign117.
Campaign117 is a single raw-source state definition frozen without component values or return-fitted weights; it is not a refit, rescue, subset or ensemble of terminal scores.

independence_interventions: Apply a common strictly increasing transform to all 240 amount values: Campaign117 is unchanged while amount mass, path-difference and cardinal-correlation factors generally change.
Permute amount positions inside a half while preserving the unordered amount multiset: amount participation entropy is unchanged while Campaign117 can change.
Change every OHLC and return value while preserving amount: Campaign117 is unchanged while all price, return, range and price-activity factors may change.
Construct two sequences with the same strict local-peak count but redistribute nonpeak weak-order states: peak density is unchanged while Campaign117 can change.

decision.next_stage: Freeze the full ordered coverage-capacity-uniqueness-development protocol and bind the implementation before opening source values.
